rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with an expanded 3AC blastocyst and appropriately notes thinned zona and weak TE, but it is internally inconsistent about ICM quality and speculates about collapse/irregular structures not firmly supported from a single image.
Strong integration of age, prior IVF failures, ovarian reserve markers, tubal factor, smoking, sperm parameters, and endometrial thickness with embryo morphology and prognosis.
Overall logic is reasonable, but the response contains noticeable contradictions and drift in probability estimates and morphology interpretation before settling on a final range.

Largely aligned with IVF practice and Gardner-based interpretation, including emphasis on age-related aneuploidy, hydrosalpinx evaluation, smoking cessation, luteal support, and avoiding bed rest; minor overreach in some numerical estimates.

Provides practical next steps for transfer and future review, including luteal support, smoking cessation, tubal assessment, and preconception optimization, though future-cycle planning is somewhat incomplete/truncated.
